about_the_game:
Astro Delivery is a 2D platformer focused on speed, precision, and route optimization. In each level, the goal is simple: pick up the package and deliver it to the door before time runs out. However, achieving a perfect run will require planning, quick reflexes, and mastery of the environment.

Designed to be accessible on the surface but challenging in depth, the game rewards both casual players who want to complete levels and competitive players who aim to master them. With a star-rating system based on time and hidden shortcuts, each level offers multiple ways to be completed, encouraging replayability and constant improvement.

Key Features:

  • Tight controls and responsive movement.

  • Mini puzzles and interactive mechanics like buttons, moving platforms, and timed traps.

  • Star rating system that rewards speed and efficiency.

  • Hidden routes and alternative paths to optimize delivery time.

  • Clear, minimalistic visual style focused on readability and gameplay flow.

Astro Delivery is built for players who enjoy the challenge of refining their performance and want a fast-paced, skill-based experience.
